Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$380,000, 5 bed, 3.00 bath, 3,067 SF, MLS# 564127

Ahhh!  Stretch Out. Relax and enjoy life more in this 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home that offers over 3,000 square feet of living space on two floors. Designed for both comfort, style or the growing family.  From the open kitchen to the liberally sized living family, this residence features ample room for family gathering, making memories and entertainment. Enjoy the luxury and of two separate living room areas, perfect for entertaining or family relaxation after a long day at work.   A modern kitchen that a chef would die for.  Convenient double oven, great for those holiday meals cooked up for family and friends, granite counter tops, oversize kitchen island.  In-laws' bedroom and bathroom on the bottom floor, master bedroom on second floor includes a walk-in closet, providing ample storage and a touch of luxury. Four additional bedrooms offer generous space for family members or guests, each designed with comfort in mind.  The dedicated laundry area comes equipped with a sink, adding functionality and ease to household chores. With 3,000 square feet, this home offers abundant space for all your needs. extended enclosed patio for outside entertainment or BBQ get together with family and friends.  The are so many possibilities, memories and excitement can be made at this address. Situated in one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Copperas Cove, it is close to local, schools, and parks, the by-pass around the city and short driving distance to the city's shopping district making it an ideal choice for families and a place to call home. You can't overlook this home. A real treasure.

3 full bath
